why: A clean one-fraction linear equation with an integer root, correctly weighted at 2 marks (clear the denominator, collect terms) in SEAB register; it is not a re-skin of the two-summed-fractions form (2012 P1 Q8) or the bare two-sided equation (2025 P1 Q5a).
